title: Stop Saying "Very Worried"! 3 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very worried". Use one of these words instead:
• Anxious: My exam is tomorrow. I feel anxious.
• On edge: I can't sit still. I'm on edge.
• Worried sick: I can't sleep. I'm worried sick.

Comment your own word for "very worried"!
